scientific_integrity: Self-contained finite-geometry and permanent two-pebble arguments; finite programs are supporting cross-checks, not a substitute for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Assumes an orthogonal polarity with exactly q+1 absolute points, retains loops, and uses a counting-free binary signature; no generalization to other polarities, counting logic, or higher variable widths. Historical priority and mathematical correctness remain independently unaudited.
title: Four unrestricted two-variable theories of orthogonal polarities in finite projective planes
